item.title: [ransomware] War spreads into cyberspace after Iran-linked hackers hit medtech giant Stryker
item.description: <p>An Iran-linked hacking group has claimed responsibility for a cyberattack on U.S. medical device giant Stryker, marking a potential escalation of cyber activity tied to the ongoing conflict in the Middle East. Stryker confirmed in a Form 8-K filing with the SEC that a cyberattack caused a global disruption to its Microsoft systems.
